mechanism: Fluoxetine inhibits CYP2D6 metabolism of prochlorperazine, increasing its plasma concentration; additive CNS depression and serotonergic effects; potential for neuroleptic malignant syndrome risk.
action: Monitor for increased prochlorperazine adverse effects (sedation, extrapyramidal symptoms); consider dose reduction of prochlorperazine or alternative antiemetic; educate patient on CNS depression signs.
